result.instructions: Tools for Directo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have orders still marked NEW, and what are their totals?"; "List the items in warehouse AALTR with fewer than 10 in stock."; "Show sales invoices issued to customer CUST001 this quarter.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Directo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run directo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run directo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run directo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. directo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: directo_get_api_description
tools.title: Get API description
tools.description: Show which resources and filter names this Directo API key can read (GET /v1/openapi.json). Call it first to learn the field names for the other tools.

tools.name: directo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customer cards (code, name, country, city, VAT number, payment terms, credit limit, contacts). Filter by code, name, country, closed or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/customers.

code.description: Code (exact match), for example K001. Use !K001 to exclude it.

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code, for example EE or !EE. Comma list: EE,LV,LT.

ts.description: Only records changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example >2026-11-20T07:00:00Z (use this for incremental sync).

tools.name: directo_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List item cards (code, name, class, unit, price, supplier, barcode, weight) with stock quantity by warehouse. Filter by code, name, class, status, warehouse, country, quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/items.

code.description: Code (exact match), for example K001. Use !K001 to exclude it.

class.description: Item class code, for example KAUP.

status.description: Status code, for example NEW or CLOSED. Comma list allowed: NEW,PENDING. Use !CLOSED to exclude.

warehouse.description: Warehouse code, for example AALTR. Comma list allowed.

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code, for example EE or !EE. Comma list: EE,LV,LT.

quantity.description: Quantity with an operator, for example >10 or <5.

ts.description: Only records changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example >2026-11-20T07:00:00Z (use this for incremental sync).

tools.name: directo_list_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders with their lines (header fields plus row_* line fields). Filter by number, date, status, customer_code, row_item, warehouse, closed or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/orders.

date.description: Document date with an operator, for example >2026-09-01T00:00:00 or <2026-12-31T23:59:59.

status.description: Status code, for example NEW or CLOSED. Comma list allowed: NEW,PENDING. Use !CLOSED to exclude.

row_item.description: Item code on a document line, for example 9810. Matches documents that contain the item.

warehouse.description: Warehouse code, for example AALTR. Comma list allowed.

ts.description: Only records changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example >2026-11-20T07:00:00Z (use this for incremental sync).

tools.name: directo_list_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with their lines (header fields plus row_* line fields). Filter by number, date, customer_code, row_item, row_quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/invoices.

date.description: Document date with an operator, for example >2026-09-01T00:00:00 or <2026-12-31T23:59:59.

row_item.description: Item code on a document line, for example 9810. Matches documents that contain the item.

row_quantity.description: Quantity on a line, with an operator, for example >10.

ts.description: Only records changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example >2026-11-20T07:00:00Z (use this for incremental sync).

tools.name: directo_list_stock_levels
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List stock quantities per item and warehouse. Filter by code, warehouse, quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/stocklevels.

code.description: Code (exact match), for example K001. Use !K001 to exclude it.

warehouse.description: Warehouse code, for example AALTR. Comma list allowed.

quantity.description: Quantity with an operator, for example >10 or <5.

ts.description: Only records changed since this time, ISO 8601, for example >2026-11-20T07:00:00Z (use this for incremental sync).

tools.name: directo_list_records
tools.title: List records of any resource
tools.description: Read any other enabled resource, for example suppliers, purchase_invoices, receipts (incoming payments), projects, accounts or transactions. Pass the resource name and optional filters as field name → value pairs; get the field names from directo_get_api_description. Directo API: GET /v1/{resource}.

resource.description: The resource to read, for example suppliers or receipts.

filters.description: Filter name → value, for example { "ts": ">2026-11-20T07:00:00Z" }. Names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*.
